generation_notes: Generate ONLY FIRST slice of ONE very tall 3-slice poster. Portrait 1024x1536. Exact Chinese title 让想法成为作品 near top, secondary text 看见问题 in middle. Beautiful editorial gouache illustration of a magnifying glass inspecting a tiny orange seed and sketchbook, navy and ochre on warm ivory #F6F2E7. Plenty of negative space. At bottom 220 pixels, absolutely uniform solid warm ivory background, no objects, no text, no shadows, no gradients. Full-bleed background to every edge, no border. NO footer or separate-card effect. A tasteful first slice with unresolved downward flow. No other text.

Continue BELOW the previous actual slice, never reproduce its title or illustration. Top 220px empty identical ivory background. Center editorial illustration of a navy winding road and orange pencil drawing a plan, text exactly 画出路径. Bottom 200px ivory and a single thin dark navy vertical road line centered at x=512, 12 pixels wide, crossing the bottom edge vertically. All important content in y=300..1150. No footer, no total title.

Continue BELOW the previous actual slice. Top 200px same warm ivory background and one navy vertical line centered x=512 width12 continuing downwards into editorial illustration of a completed small orange-and-navy paper kite. Text exactly 动手完成, centered and readable. This is the last slice: finish with a small orange dot, calm conclusion. No repeated title or prior content.
